title: VPC health-exporter sidecar: unified SLO probes for latency, errors, saturation and token throughput
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Private (VPC) deployments currently surface multiple siloed probes (kube liveness, app-level error counters, infra-level GPU metrics). This makes SLO alignment and incident detection noisy for token-heavy workloads. We need a single lightweight sidecar health-exporter that aggregates and normalizes latency, error rate, saturation, and token-throughput signals into a consistent probe surface for the control plane and alerting.
acceptance_criteria: Sidecar runs as non-root container and exposes a Prometheus-compatible /metrics endpoint with documented metric names
Exports normalized 50p/95p/99p request latency buckets (ms) per route and model variant
Exports error-rate counters broken down by class (5xx, 4xx, timeout, internal) and maps to a single error_rate_pct metric
Exports saturation signals: CPU%, GPU% (if available), queue depth and a derived saturation_score (0-100)
Exports token_throughput_per_sec and token_backpressure_event_count with clear semantics
Works with existing Terraform module (private/vpc) and toggles via Helm values or Terraform var
Automated smoke test that verifies metrics emitted under synthetic load in the staging VPC
Documentation + runbook updated and an example alert rule for critical SLO breach is merged
design_notes: Architecture: small Go sidecar that subscribes to local unix socket telemetry and samples runtime metrics via /admin endpoints; falls back to kube cAdvisor where necessary
Sampling and cardinality: avoid high-cardinality labels; route/model labels limited to a whitelist configured via configmap
Latency: compute p50/p95/p99 histograms with dynamic buckets tuned for typical LLM generation times (10ms buckets under 200ms, 100ms buckets up to 10s)
Saturation_score: weighted sum of GPU_util*0.5 + CPU_util*0.2 + queue_depth_normalized*0.3, exposes both raw components and final score
Token throughput definition: successful_generated_tokens / wall_clock_interval; backpressure_event increments when KV cache miss rate causes >Xms stall
Security: metrics endpoint limited to cluster-internal network and authenticated via mTLS when in private control plane; no PII emitted
Performance: sidecar target memory < 40MB, CPU < 50m under steady-state; ensure it does not interfere with inference latency
rollout_plan: 1) Implement sidecar and unit tests in feature branch
2) Deploy to staging VPC via Terraform module toggled off-by-default; enable for a single canary pool
3) Run synthetic token-heavy traffic (from perf harness) and validate metric fidelity
4) Create canary alert rules that only fire in staging; iterate thresholds
5) Gradual enablement: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% of private workers over 2 weeks with automatic rollback on error_rate_pct > 2% or saturation_score > 85
6) Post-rollout audit: compare sidecar metrics to existing GPU/exporter baselines and adjust weightings
7) Ship docs and runbook, schedule on-call walkthrough and PagerDuty integration
